newsSection.item4Desc: A faculty research team published a new study focused on practical data science applications.
newsSection.item1Content: The faculty welcomes researchers and students to a focused program of talks and discussions about recent developments in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.

newsSection.item3Content: Applications are now open for the new academic year. Applicants can review the available postgraduate tracks and admission requirements.
newsSection.item4Content: The research team shared new findings that demonstrate practical uses of data science methods in real-world projects.

about.title: Faculty of Computers and Data Science
about.intro: We prepare a generation of specialists capable of leading digital transformation, through modern academic programs and a research environment that supports innovation.
about.visionText: To be a regionally leading faculty in computing and data science education and research by 2030.
about.missionText: To provide outstanding education and applied research that keeps pace with labor market needs and serves the community.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.text: We strive for excellence in everything we teach and research.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.text: We encourage creative thinking and solving problems in new ways.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.text: We uphold the highest standards of academic and professional honesty.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.text: We believe in the power of teamwork between students and faculty.

about.historyText: The faculty was founded to meet the growing need for computing and data science specialists, and has continued to expand its programs and departments over the years.
